COMPLEXITY_FIREWALL.bit_complexity_requirement_for_future_pa: all exact weighted states and updates must have polynomial bit length and r^O(1) bit-operation complexity

HRAIN_RED_TEAM.earliest_counterexample_rule: Prefer the earliest exact reachable HPS counterexample to a proposed compression over any large empirical sweep.

PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.PASS_OMEGA_BAR14_SUFFICIENT_THROUGH_TAU2: Exact tau24 propagation is determined by the compressed tau14 state through OmegaBar_14 without restoring branch-resolved tau14 information.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.ONE_NEW_WEIGHTED_HIGHER_ORDER_SCALAR_EXP: May be recorded separately if exactly one new weighted statistic is exposed at tau24; this does not negate OmegaBar sufficiency.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.PASS_BRANCH_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED: An exact future-equivalence counterexample proves that equal OmegaBar_14 can yield different tau24 propagated outputs, so branch-resolved or other exact C4 information is necessary.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.OPEN_NO_PROOF_NO_FALSIFIER: Neither sufficiency nor a rigorous branch-resolution counterexample is established.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.FAIL: Only a rigorous falsifier of the entire frozen local tau24 state-sufficiency target; failure of the diamond candidate or one compression is not FAIL.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.post_pass_firewall: No local outcome proves the full sign oracle, selector A, H1/H2/H3, SAT_IN_P, or P_VS_NP.

NEXT_SINGLE_GATE.stop_rule: If a genuinely new statistic is exposed, freeze it and STOP; do not automatically construct C5 or propagate tau34.
